modules.rationale: gate-8 no-clause tail; no non-tautological clause remains that is expressible without restating the iterator protocol. Reclassify per function in B2.
gate-8 no-clause tail; platform/OS preconditions are currently documented at the platform layer. Reclassify per function in B2 (expected EX-2 shims).
gate-8 no-clause tail; domain-closed numeric helpers where the remaining clause would be tautological. Reclassify per function in B2 (expected EX-1 totals).
Total sleep helper: negative durations are clamped to 0 and the timing postcondition is outside the clause language.
Total runtime predicate: the Bool identifies the main thread and no stronger postcondition is available.
Structured-concurrency primitive: the runtime/scope owns join semantics and the callback return is the result.
Total scheduler hint with no return value; the side effect is not modeled by the clause language.
Total sequential loop over [start, end); no precondition and the callback carries the effect.
Dynamic-loader shim: the OS loader defines success/failure and the Result carries the handle or error; a clause would restate the ABI.
Dynamic-loader symbol lookup shim: the OS loader and the Result define the contract; a clause would restate the ABI.
Total diagnostic helper with no return value; the only postcondition is a stderr write, which the clause language does not model.
Total deallocation primitive; the SafePtr owned/ptr fields are the ownership contract and the call has no return value to constrain.
gate-8 no-clause tail; total parser/serializer helpers over internal state. Reclassify per function in B2.
